title: Ethiopian Potato and Carrot Alicha
localName: ድንች ካሮት አልጫ — Dinich Karot Alicha
community: All of Ethiopia — the mild root vegetable combination
author: Mama Tigist
desc: Ethiopian Potato and Carrot Alicha — potatoes and carrots cooked in a mild turmeric and ginger sauce without berbere. The golden-yellow mild root vegetable stew that children and heat-sensitive guests can enjoy fully.
longDesc: Potato and carrot alicha is the mild filling element of the fasting platter — providing sustained energy from root vegetables with gentle turmeric and ginger spicing.
steps: Heat oil. Cook onion until golden.
Add garlic, ginger, and turmeric. Stir 1 minute.
Add water. Cover. Cook 22—25 minutes until very tender.
chefTips: No berbere — the mildness is intentional.
cookingScience: See ETH116 for potato stew science.
sustainabilityTips: Root vegetables — affordable, nutritious, locally grown.
servedWith: On the fasting platter as the mild element
culturalNote: The mild potato and carrot alicha ensures that the fasting platter welcomes every guest — from the youngest child to the oldest elder — regardless of their tolerance for heat.
